Andy! Are you okay?\f
Andy!\f
I'm... so... groggy...\f
Wake up!\f
Huh?\fOh... morning, Sami.\f

Unbelievable! Here I am, working my\rtail off, and you're sleeping!\fWhy am I the only one who's\rtaking these things seriously?\fSonja's been leading us around by\rour noses like a bunch of sheep!\fOooh...! She makes me so mad!\fEver since we were classmates,\rshe's been the Queen of Strategy.\fNow here I am, losing units left and\rright, and my allies are all sleeping!\fGet up and get moving, Andy!\rIt's up to you. Orange Star did not\rattack Green Earth.\f
But, we saw...\f
We saw what we were meant to see!\rAnd this goes beyond the battles in\fGreen Earth. This entire conflict has\rbeen orchestrated from the beginning.\f
But how...\f
Quiet! Now, if I'm right, we'll have to\rturn the tides on our mystery foe.\fThe best way to test my theory\ris to battle Orange Star again.\f

That was pretty tight!
I won... somehow.
